title: Film Terakhir di Bioskop Cahaya
theme: Melalui eksplorasi sebuah bioskop tua yang terbengkalai, seorang penulis menemukan bahwa kenangan dan cerita masa lalu tetap hidup, meskipun dalam kesunyian yang memilukan.

cover.prompt: An environmental shot depicting winding city pathways with cracked pavement, bathed in intense midday sun. Irregular architecture with an aged building facade fills the scene. A distant, subtle silhouette of a person is visible, holding an old notebook, navigating the intricate city layout. Cinematic composition with rule of thirds, shallow depth of field, warm, high-contrast lighting. Focus on the urban texture and the mood of an unfolding journey.
cover.style: Cinematic photography, shallow depth of field, warm color grading

meta.plan_summary: A young writer, Clara, explores an abandoned old cinema, discovering forgotten stories, a hidden film, and a heartfelt letter from the last projectionist, inspiring her to revive its legacy through her writing.
